recordDailyMeasurements.name: Record Daily Measurements
recordDailyMeasurements.description: Log your biomarkers in seconds. Build a template for your routine tests so you only see the markers you care about. Whether you use a Fora 6, Qardio smart scale, or get lab work done, everything goes into one secure place.

supportedDevices.name: Supported Devices
supportedDevices.description: Works with home testing devices like the Fora 6 multi-parameter meter (glucose, ketones, cholesterol, uric acid, hemoglobin, hematocrit), Qardio Arm blood pressure monitor, Qardiobase 2 smart scale (weight, body fat, muscle mass, water, bone mass), and any lab provider. You can also add your own devices and define what they measure.

measurementTemplates.name: Measurement Templates
measurementTemplates.description: Save your routine as a template. Select the markers you measure regularly, give it a name, and load it with one tap next time.

calculatedHealthScores.name: Calculated Health Scores
calculatedHealthScores.description: Automatically calculated from your base measurements. BMI from weight and height. HOMA-IR from glucose and insulin. GKI from glucose and ketones. No manual math required.

bodyComposition.name: Body Composition
bodyComposition.description: Track body fat percentage, muscle mass, water percentage, and bone mass alongside your weight.

editAndCorrect.name: Edit and Correct
editAndCorrect.description: Made a mistake? Edit or delete any measurement at any time. Full control over every data point.

labResultImport.name: Lab Result Import
labResultImport.description: Photo or PDF of your lab report. Auto-extracted, reviewed by you before saving.

medicationImport.name: Medication Import
medicationImport.description: Photo of supplement bottles. Identified and logged automatically.

markerDetailPages.name: Marker Detail Pages
markerDetailPages.description: Every marker has a dedicated page that explains what it measures and why it matters. Written in plain language that anyone can understand.

foodRecommendations.name: Food Recommendations
foodRecommendations.description: See which foods can help improve each marker. From grass-fed beef and salmon to blueberries and dark chocolate, organized by category with explanations.

supplementGuidance.name: Supplement Guidance
supplementGuidance.description: Evidence-based supplement suggestions for each marker. Includes typical dosage ranges, timing tips, and how each supplement affects your numbers.

fastingImpact.name: Fasting Impact
fastingImpact.description: 22 markers have fasting-specific reference ranges with explanations. Understand why your glucose drops, ketones rise, and uric acid increases during a fast.

markerRelationships.name: Marker Relationships
markerRelationships.description: See how your markers connect to each other. Over 30 documented relationships help you see the bigger picture.

protocolGuides.name: Protocol Guides
protocolGuides.description: What happens to your markers on carnivore? How does keto affect your insulin? Six diet protocols mapped against 20+ markers.

trendCharts.name: Trend Charts
trendCharts.description: Interactive charts showing your marker values over time with colored reference range bands.

compareProtocols.name: Compare Protocols
compareProtocols.description: Changed your diet? See exactly how your markers responded. Side-by-side comparison of different phases.

aiDashboardInsights.name: AI Dashboard Insights

communityComparison.name: Community Comparison

generalHealthQA.name: General Health Q&A

trendAnalysis.name: Trend Analysis
trendAnalysis.description: One tap and Dr. Alex reviews your last 60 days. What improved, what needs attention, clear next steps.

labResultExplanation.name: Lab Result Explanation

personalizedNutrition.name: Personalized Nutrition

supplementReview.name: Supplement Review

protocolComparison.name: Protocol Comparison
protocolComparison.description: Thinking about changing your diet? Dr. Alex analyzes how your markers performed across protocols.

trackWhatYouTake.name: Track What You Take

interactionWarnings.name: Interaction Warnings
interactionWarnings.description: Iron and zinc compete for absorption. Our database flags conflicts.

impactOnYourMarkers.name: Impact on Your Markers
impactOnYourMarkers.description: See which supplements affect which markers over time.

fullDataExport.name: Full Data Export
fullDataExport.description: Download everything as JSON or CSV. No lock-in.

accountDeletion.name: Account Deletion
accountDeletion.description: Delete your account and all data. 30-day grace period. GDPR compliant.

encryptionAtRest.name: Encryption at Rest (AES-256-GCM)
encryptionAtRest.description: Your health data is encrypted when stored. Even in the unlikely event of a server breach, your data remains unreadable and protected.

encryptionInTransit.name: Encryption in Transit (TLS 1.3)
encryptionInTransit.description: All data between your browser and our servers is encrypted with the latest TLS standard. No one can intercept your health information.

zeroKnowledgeDesign.name: Zero-Knowledge Design
zeroKnowledgeDesign.description: Platform administrators cannot read your health data. Even with full database access, measurement values remain encrypted and unreadable without the separate encryption key.

twoFactorAuth.name: Two-Factor Authentication (TOTP)
twoFactorAuth.description: Secure your account with app-based 2FA. Even if your password is compromised, your health data stays protected.

anonymousAi.name: Anonymous AI

noTracking.name: No Third-Party Tracking
noTracking.description: Zero analytics cookies, no tracking pixels, no data brokers. Your browsing and health data are never shared with advertisers.

gdprEprivacy.name: GDPR and ePrivacy Compliant

hero.title: Built by Someone Who Needed It

story.paragraph1: My name is Helmut, and for the past several years I have been on a journey to take back control of the systems that run my life. It started with money when I discovered Bitcoin in 2017 and became a maximalist by 2023. The idea that a decentralized protocol could replace the need to trust banks and governments resonated deeply with me, and it changed how I think about everything.
story.paragraph2: In 2025, I applied the same philosophy to my health and went carnivore. Not because a YouTube influencer convinced me, but because I wanted to reduce the noise and focus on the signal. Only real food, no highly processed ingredients, no seed oils. The results were remarkable, but I did not want to just feel better. I wanted to measure it and prove it to myself with data.
story.paragraph3: So I started tracking my biomarkers obsessively. Twice a week, every Tuesday and Friday morning, I prick my finger with a Fora 6 device and measure glucose, ketones, cholesterol, uric acid, hemoglobin, and hematocrit. I step on my Qardio smart scale for weight and body composition. Once a year I get a comprehensive blood panel done by a professional lab, covering over 40 additional markers including hormones, thyroid, liver, kidneys, vitamins, and inflammation.
story.paragraph4: I tried multiple health tracking apps from different companies, but every single one held my data hostage in their proprietary cloud. I could not export it properly, I could not analyze it the way I wanted to, and I certainly could not trust them with my most sensitive personal information. I ended up tracking over 80 biomarkers in Excel because at least there I had sovereign access to my own health data.
story.paragraph5: I described this entire journey in my book "Brick by Brick," where I write about taking back control of your health, your finances, and your data, one decision at a time. You can find it here:
story.paragraph6: Out of this experience, and driven by my curiosity for building with AI tools like OpenClaw and Claude Code, I decided to create the app I wished existed. Sovereign Health is the open source version that anyone can self-host for free on their own hardware. Your server, your data, your rules. Sovereign Health Intelligence is the hosted platform for those who prefer convenience, with AI-powered analysis, smart import, medication tracking, and team features on top.
story.paragraph7: The platform is fully encrypted, fully GDPR compliant, and designed so that even as the operator, I cannot read your health data. That is not a marketing claim. It is an architectural decision baked into the code, which you can verify yourself because the source is open.
story.paragraph8: This is not a venture-funded startup chasing growth metrics. This is one person building a tool that solves a real problem, sharing it with the world, and offering a premium version for those who want more. Decentralize everything. Verify, do not trust. Brick by brick. Or should I say, blood drop by drop?

energyMetabolic.name: Energy and Metabolic
energyMetabolic.description: Blood sugar, insulin, ketones, and the markers that determine how your body produces and uses energy. Essential for anyone tracking fasting, keto, or carnivore protocols.

structural.name: Structural
structural.description: Body composition, bone health, and structural integrity. Track weight, body fat, muscle mass, BMI, and waist-to-height ratio to see how your body is physically changing.

cardiovascular.name: Cardiovascular
cardiovascular.description: Heart and blood vessel health. Cholesterol panels, blood pressure, heart rate, and calculated ratios like TG/HDL that give you a real picture of cardiovascular risk.

cognitive.name: Cognitive
cognitive.description: Brain health and nervous system markers. Vitamins, minerals, and biomarkers that influence cognitive function, mood, and mental clarity.

immune.name: Immune
immune.description: Inflammation, white blood cells, and immune system function. CRP, ESR, and complete blood count markers that show how well your body defends itself.

nutritional.name: Nutritional
nutritional.description: Vitamins, minerals, and essential nutrients. From iron and ferritin to vitamin D and zinc, see if your diet is giving you what you need.

hormonal.name: Hormonal
hormonal.description: Thyroid, testosterone, cortisol, and other hormones that regulate everything from energy to mood. Track changes over time to understand your hormonal balance.

detoxification.name: Detoxification
detoxification.description: Liver and kidney function markers. ALT, AST, GGT, creatinine, and eGFR tell you how well your organs are filtering and processing.

Patients become active participants in their health journey, and you get better data to work with. The Horizon tier includes multi-patient oversight so you can monitor trends across your practice.

deviceManufacturers.title: Device Manufacturers
deviceManufacturers.description: Your hardware generates valuable health data. Make sure it reaches your customers in a platform they actually control. Sovereign Health supports open device integrations and gives users full ownership of their measurements. By partnering with us, your device becomes part of a privacy-first ecosystem that health-conscious users actively seek out. We handle the software, you handle the hardware.

contentContributors.title: Content and Knowledge Contributors
contentContributors.description: Our knowledge base covers 85+ markers with plain-language descriptions, food recommendations, supplement guidance, and protocol effects. Medical professionals, nutritionists, and researchers can contribute to make it better. All contributions are open source, credited, and help thousands of users understand their health data. If you have expertise in metabolic health, we want to hear from you.

hero.title: Security & Trust
hero.tagline: Transparency builds trust. Here is exactly how we protect your data.

intro.paragraph1: Health data is among the most sensitive information a person can have. Where you store it, who can access it, and how it is protected are not minor details. They are the foundation of any health platform worth using.
intro.paragraph2: Sovereign Health Intelligence was built from day one with a single architectural principle: we should not be able to read your health data, even if we wanted to. This is not a marketing claim. It is a technical decision baked into the code, which you can verify yourself because the source is open.
intro.paragraph3: This page explains our security approach in detail. Every claim made here is verifiable in the source code.

dataSovereignty.title: Data Sovereignty
dataSovereignty.description: Your data belongs to you. Export it anytime as JSON or CSV. Delete your account and all data is removed within 30 days. We never lock you in.

openSource.title: Open Source
openSource.description: Our core technology is AGPL-3.0 licensed. Every line of code is publicly auditable. You do not have to trust our claims. You can verify them.

privacyByDesign.title: Privacy by Design
privacyByDesign.description: No tracking, no profiling, no behavioral analytics. We do not monitor how you use the platform. We do not build user profiles for any purpose.

minimalData.title: Minimal Data Collection
minimalData.description: We collect only what is needed to provide the service: your email, your health measurements (encrypted), and your preferences. Nothing more.

aes256.title: AES-256-GCM Encryption at Rest
aes256.description: All health measurement values are encrypted using AES-256-GCM before being written to the database. The encryption key is stored separately from the database.

tls13.title: TLS 1.3 Encryption in Transit
tls13.description: All communication between your browser and our servers uses TLS 1.3, the latest transport layer security protocol.

zeroKnowledge.title: Zero-Knowledge Architecture
zeroKnowledge.description: Platform administrators cannot read your health data. Even with full database access, measurement values remain encrypted and unreadable without the separate encryption key.

noAnalytics.title: No Third-Party Analytics
noAnalytics.description: No Google Analytics, no Plausible, no tracking pixels, no cookies (except one optional referral cookie). No browser fingerprinting. No device identifiers.

docker.title: Containerized Deployment
docker.description: The platform runs in isolated Docker containers with minimal attack surface. Each service (API, frontend, database) runs in its own container.

securityUpdates.title: Regular Security Updates
securityUpdates.description: Dependencies are kept up to date. The Rust backend provides memory safety guarantees. OWASP Top 10 protections are implemented throughout the stack.

gdpr.title: GDPR Compliant
gdpr.description: Full compliance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation. Data stored in EU (Lithuania). Full data portability and right to erasure built into the platform.

austrianEcg.title: Austrian ECG / Impressum
austrianEcg.description: Operated under Austrian law with full legal disclosure per the Austrian E-Commerce Act (ECG). See our Impressum for complete details.

ageRequirement.title: 18+ Age Requirement
ageRequirement.description: The platform is intended for adults only. Accounts created by users under 18 will be deleted upon discovery.

refundPolicy.title: 30-Day Refund Policy
refundPolicy.description: Full refund within 30 days of your first paid subscription, no questions asked. After 30 days, your subscription continues until the end of the billing period.

dataExport.title: Full Data Export
dataExport.description: Download your complete health history as JSON or CSV anytime from the application. Generate PDF health reports for your doctor.

dataDeletion.title: Data Deletion on Request
dataDeletion.description: Delete your account from Settings at any time. All data removed from the primary database within 30 days. Encrypted backups purged within 90 days.

stripe.title: Stripe (PCI DSS Compliant)
stripe.description: Credit card payments are processed by Stripe, a PCI DSS Level 1 certified payment processor. We never see or store your card details.

btcpay.title: BTCPay Server (Self-Hosted)
btcpay.description: Bitcoin payments are processed through our self-hosted BTCPay Server instance. No third-party payment processor involved for cryptocurrency payments.

noPaymentData.title: No Payment Data Stored
noPaymentData.description: We do not store credit card numbers, CVVs, or any payment credentials on our servers. All payment data is handled by Stripe or BTCPay Server.

bitcoinDiscount.title: 5% Bitcoin Discount
bitcoinDiscount.description: Pay with Bitcoin for privacy-preserving payments and receive a 5% discount. Bitcoin payments do not require sharing personal financial information.

openSource.heading: Open Source Commitment
openSource.description: Our core technology is open source under the AGPL-3.0 license. The backend, frontend, and database schema are all publicly available. Community contributions are welcome. We believe that open source is the only way to build real trust in a health platform.

aiAssisted.title: AI-Assisted, Not AI-Decided
aiAssisted.description: Dr. Alex provides AI-powered insights to help you understand your health data. All analysis is informational. The AI does not make decisions for you.

noMedicalAdvice.title: Not Medical Advice
noMedicalAdvice.description: Sovereign Health Intelligence is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice. Always consult your doctor for medical decisions.

noAiTraining.title: Your Data Does Not Train AI
noAiTraining.description: AI queries are sent to Anthropic Claude with anonymized context only. Your name, email, and identifying information are never included. Your data is not used to train AI models.

noDataSharing.title: Health Data Never Shared or Sold
noDataSharing.description: Your health data is never shared with third parties, never sold, and never used for advertising. This is a core architectural commitment, not a policy that can be changed.

contact.heading: Report a Security Issue
contact.description: If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it responsibly. We take every report seriously and will respond promptly.
